items.title: 3 US Chip Stocks for AI Exposure With Lower China Risk
items.summary: Nvidia’s internal probe into CEO Jensen Huang and possible foreign intelligence targeting has put governance and national security risk in the spotlight, and that ripple hits anything tied to the AI chip story. Investors hunting for exposure without leaning heavily on China are now scanning for alternatives that could benefit as attention broadens. This article walks through three U.S. listed semiconductor and chip equipment stocks from our low China exposure screener that appear most closely...

items.title: The Pentagon is reportedly ramping up economic warfare and espionage. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy shows why
items.summary: "While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information."
